small_guidance:
- Add larger tile configs to the autotune list (BLOCK_OW=128/BLOCK_OH=2, BLOCK_OW=64/BLOCK_OH=8) with num_warps=8 to amortize the OC=64 outer-product cost across more output pixels per program.
- The acc tensor is [OC=64, BLOCK_OH, BLOCK_OW]; with BLOCK_OH*BLOCK_OW=128 this is 32KB of registers per program — try shrinking to BLOCK_OH*BLOCK_OW≈64 (e.g. 32×2 or 16×4) with num_warps=4 to reduce register pressure / spills, or conversely persist the kernel over a larger output area to amortize the weight reload.
- Preload all weights for the current (kh,kw) across all IC into registers once per (kh,kw) by reordering to load a [IC] vector of w per oc — currently loading [OC] weights inside the IC loop repeats KH*KW*IC*N*OH*OW/(BLOCK) loads; consider loading w as [OC, IC] block per (kh,kw) using tl.load with a 2D index.
large_guidance:
- Rewrite as an im2col-style GEMM: per program compute a tile of [BLOCK_M output pixels × BLOCK_N=OC=64] by looping K=IC*KH*KW with BLOCK_K=32, using tl.dot. This leverages tensor cores (fp32 via TF32) and is far more efficient than the current explicit outer-product accumulation in registers. Fuse the channel-min + double-tanh in the epilogue after the dot.
- Alternatively, since the channel reduction is min (not sum), keep the gather-style conv but parallelize one program per (N, output-tile) with OC fully resident, and use tl.dot(w_tile[OC, BLOCK_K], x_tile[BLOCK_K, BLOCK_HW]) to get the [OC, BLOCK_HW] pre-min tensor — same math as now but via MMA instead of scalar FMAs.
- Switch input layout to NHWC (channels-last) so the GEMM-K axis (IC) is contiguous; do a one-time permute of weights at init and permute input in forward (or fuse the layout into the kernel's index math). This makes the im2col K-loop coalesced.
